_help: Book-specific settings for scripts/engine.py. Fill every value FROM THE SOURCE (Phase A). Keys starting with _help are ignored. Omit any key to use the engine default.

metadata._help: Only what the source states. null when not stated. Never from outside knowledge.
metadata.genre: e.g. hadith_collection | tafsir | fiqh | history | biography | poetry | adab
metadata.structure_summary: one sentence describing the discovered structure

unit_type: e.g. hadith | biography | poem | mas'ala | event
body_role: role name for the unit's main text, e.g. hadith_text | narrative | verse | text
main_type: type of the node holding the units, e.g. hadith_collection

front_matter.title: e.g. title page and publication data

main_start_at._help: optional: where the main text starts if something of the author precedes unit 1; delete if not needed

sections._help: optional: headed sections before the main text, in book order, with levels (see SKILL.md)
sections.title: مقدمة المحقق

back_matter._help: one entry per back-matter block (index, bibliography, colophon); start_at = text of its first line, as in the OCR
back_matter.title: الفهرس

running_headers: _help: exact text of repeated page headers, as the OCR shows them (see engine.py discover)
unit_headings: _help: the unit headings IN BOOK ORDER, spelled exactly as in the BODY (not the TOC). Use an object when needed:

footnote_split._help: where the editor's footnote switches from one role to another (e.g. takhrij → gharib)

attribution._help: phrases that open a source attribution after the main text

expected_components._help: components this genre usually has; status present | absent_or_undetermined

digit_lookalikes._help: optional: OCR letters used for digits in markers/numbers, only if seen in this book

layout._help: optional: page-layout rules used when pages.json has the line layout (extract_pages.py + PyMuPDF). Defaults suit printed editions; change a value only with evidence from the page images. See SKILL.md, Page layout.
